Question Choices: A car travels 5/6 of a mile in 3/8 of an hour. Find the speed in miles per hour. Enter only the number with no units. Give an exact fraction or a decimal rounded to the nearest thousandth.
Hints: Divide the amount by the time or other input; multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
Solution: (5/6) ÷ (3/8) = (5/6)*(8/3)=40/18=2.222... rounded to 2.222. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (5 ÷ 6) ÷ (3 ÷ 8) = 20/9. Rounded to the nearest thousandth: 2.222.

Question Choices: A turtle walks 1/5 of a mile in 1/3 of an hour. What is its speed in miles per hour? (Enter as a fraction or decimal)

Solution: (1/5) ÷ (1/3) = (1/5) × 3 = 3/5. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (1 ÷ 5) ÷ (1 ÷ 3) = 0.6.

Question Choices: What percent of 50 is 17? (Enter only the number)
Hints: Divide part by whole, then multiply by 100.
Solution: 17 ÷ 50 = 0.34 = 34%. Percent means per hundred: part ÷ whole × 100. Calculation: 17 ÷ 50 × 100 = 34. Enter 34, the percent number.
